वावदूक a. [वद् यङ् लुक् --ऊकञ्]
1 Talkative, garrulous.
--2
Eloquent.

वावयः^1 A kind of basil.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170131. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: Presume AP and MW and others are correct in spelling of this plant name..

वावृत् {c4c} A. (वावृत्यते)
1 To choose,
prefer, select, love; ततो
वावृत्यमानासौ रामशालां न्यविक्षत
